Location: FKiSS Events > version

Event: Version(version number)

Related Events: set, col, begin
See also: FKiSS, Events, Actions

Version(version number)

First defined in: FKiSS2
The version events are called immediately after the begin event but only if the specified version of FKiSS is supported by the KiSS viewing program.
The following version numbers represent the known versions of FKiSS:
Version #FKiSS Version
0FKiSS1
1FKiSS1b
2FKiSS2
3FKiSS2.1
4FKiSS3
5FKiSS4
Additional values may be used in future versions of FKiSS.
